text:
chris: FYI queued a config-only rollout for tonight 21:00-22:00 UTC. routing.policy delta: tiered->weighted (default 0.85->0.9), tiny_batch_size 8->6, request_timeout_ms 1200->900. no code change. @anjali @marco please ACK so deploy-bot can schedule canary.
deploy-bot: Job queued: config-rollout/1788012340. Canary: 5% traffic, 30m ramp, health checks enabled. Auto-rollback on 5xx spike >1% or latency p95 increase >200ms. Change window: 21:00-22:00 UTC.
anjali: ack. quick Q — did we pin model version for dedicated customers? some tenants still on v2.2.
chris: good catch. we will pin tenant-tiered route to model=v2.2 and only enable weighted routing for public default. I'll add the pin to the config set before canary.
marco: can we keep tiny_batch at 7 instead of 6? infra said 6 increased kvcache pressure in last test. I'm +1 for 7 if it avoids mem spikes.
sre-oncall: I saw a small spike during the lab test with tiny_batch=6. If you go 7 we should monitor kvcache evictions. I'll attach a short alert for evictions >0.5%.
chris: OK switching to tiny_batch=7. update config: request_timeout_ms=900, tiny_batch=7, routing.weight=0.9 default, tenant pins for enterprise customers. Deploy-bot — reschedule with updated config.
deploy-bot: Job updated and rescheduled: config-rollout/1788012340.v2. Canary start 21:00 UTC. Hooks: smoke tests, latency p95, 5xx rate. Notifying oncall.
marco: sending a quick smoke test prompt set to canary route: `/run-smoke --set=canary-routing-basic` — will post results in 5m.
anjali: thanks. small note for release notes: mention tenant pin for enterprise + tiny_batch tweak and timeout reduction. I'll draft the blurb.
chris: if canary looks green at 21:30 we plan gradual 25% -> 50% -> 100% ramp by 21:55. manual hold if errors. Otherwise auto-finish at 22:00.
sre-oncall: +1. I'll be online during the window and watching evictions/5xx.
marco: smoke tests passed locally. no significant latency regressions.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 21:00 UTC (1788012360). Monitoring streams live: https://obs.redwood/internal/streams/1788012340
deploy-bot: Canary metrics update: 21:10 UTC — 5xx rate 0.02%, latency p95 +60ms. evictions 0.12%.
chris: looking good. proceed to 25% at 21:20.
deploy-bot: Traffic ramped to 25% at 21:20 UTC. Monitoring.
marco: seeing tiny bump in cpu on a subset but within limits.
deploy-bot: 21:35 UTC — 5xx 0.03%, p95 +75ms, evictions 0.25%.
anjali: releasing note draft: "Config-only rollout: routing policy changed to weighted default 0.9 (tenant pins retained for enterprise), tiny_batch reduced to 7 (improves latency), request timeout lowered to 900ms. Monitoring in place; rollback triggers on elevated 5xx or eviction spike." Please sanity-check.
chris: LGTM. let's finish ramp to 50 now, then full at 21:50 pending green metrics.
deploy-bot: Ramped to 50% at 21:42 UTC.
sre-oncall: still green. continuing to watch eviction trend.
deploy-bot: Final ramp to 100% at 21:52 UTC. Rollout complete at 21:55 UTC. No rollbacks triggered.
marco: confirmed no errors in logs for the canary tenants.
anjali: posted release notes to #release-notes and updated the changelog.
chris: thanks everyone. follow-up action: infra to revisit kvcache tuning next week (ticket INF-321). closing thread. :tada:
